description: This Java class represents a status report indicating that a connection has been restored. It provides a singleton-like instance via a static 'get' method and is intended for use within the messaging connectivity context for AMQP protocol in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectionRestoredStatusReport
classes.description: A final class serving as a simple report object indicating that a connection has been restored. Implements a singleton pattern with a static factory method.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static factory method returning a new instance of ConnectionRestoredStatusReport.
